description: Query normalized Census Building Permits Survey county-month rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed permit surface. Use for independently verifiable county permit totals, monthly settlement checks, and builder/market data workflows.

county_fips.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS, e.g. '48201' for Harris County, TX.

history.description: If true, returns a county time series across available partitions. Requires county_fips.

kind.description: Census BPS file kind. Defaults to current_month.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

month.description: Optional survey month, 1-12. Supply together with year unless history=true.

state_fips.description: Optional 2-digit state FIPS filter, e.g. '48' for Texas.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and partition metadata without row payloads.

year.description: Optional four-digit survey year. Supply together with month unless history=true.

name: get_census_bps_county_monthly

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.

title: Get Census Bps County Monthly
